# FlowsToken Desktop 0.7.4
<!-- release-status: unreleased -->

## English

### New

- All upstream v0.5.74–v0.6.20 updates: Git import, session manager, SSH password login, workspaces, launcher (⌘T), usage stats, Dock badge, pet controls, faster large conversations.
- Element picking in the embedded browser: click any page element to send its HTML, computed styles and a screenshot straight into the composer.

### Improvements

- Agent repetition loops are caught automatically: identical tool calls returning identical results stop re-executing, and persistent retries end the run with a clear explanation instead of burning tokens.
- Scheduled tasks support active hours, idle-only runs and NO_REPLY silence; optional cross-session memory (Agent settings) shares a MEMORY.md per project, stored in the app data directory.

### Fixes

- Fixed window zoom reset on macOS after reopening, reasoning-model menu closing, terminal renderer errors on session switch, Git tab state anomalies, design canvas first-frame flash, and chat scrollbar clipping.

### Upgrade notes

- Double-tap modifier quick panel replaced by the Launcher (⌘T); legacy quickPanel settings ignored. Desktop pet holiday bubbles and cultivation achievement themes removed; Vivi uses default themed bubble.

## 中文

### 新增

- Git 仓库一键导入项目；会话管理面板支持搜索与批量操作；SSH 远程主机支持加密密码登录；顶栏支持自定义按钮排序与版本介绍查看器；外观新增 10 款应用图标与聊天气泡样式。
- 新增「工作空间」分组、「启动器」面板（⌘T）、「用量」统计与小票分享；顶栏 Git 分支状态；Dock 待办角标；Vivi 桌宠控制；长会话与大文件更流畅。

### 改进

- 智能体陷入重复循环时自动防护：同一工具调用以相同参数反复执行且结果不变时不再空转，持续重试会终止运行并说明原因，避免白白消耗 Token。
- 定时任务支持运行时段、仅空闲运行与 NO_REPLY 静默巡检；可选跨会话记忆（Agent 设置开启）让同项目会话共享 MEMORY.md，存在应用数据目录。

### 修复

- 修复 macOS 重开窗口缩放档位回退、推理模型选择关闭菜单、切换会话终端渲染报错、Git 页签状态异常、设计画布首帧错显与滚动条裁切等问题。

### 升级注意

- 双击功能键快捷面板移除并统一改用「启动器」（⌘T），旧版 quickPanel 配置忽略；桌宠节日气泡与修仙成就主题移除，Vivi 恢复默认主题气泡。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jack2099/flowstoken-desktop/compare/v0.7.3...v0.7.4
